trust_decision.summary: Whether a caller-supplied math string may reach SymPy's eval-backed string parsing (parse_expr / sympify) with default namespaces; decided nowhere at the pinned commit; the fix adds a deny-list + restricted local/global dict wrapper (safe_parse_expr) and routes the server-side call sites through it.

landing_point.why: Advisory names authenticated RCE via parse_expr(); the /verify/math handler is the obvious authenticated route that calls parse_expr directly on request['expression'].

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /verify/batch (item type MATH with '=') via BatchVerificationService._verify_item (src/qwed_new/api/main.py:1480)

VerificationEngine.verify_math, reached by POST /verify/natural_language via ControlPlane (src/qwed_new/core/control_plane.py:126) and the consensus route via ConsensusVerifier (src/qwed_new/core/consensus_verifier.py:569, src/qwed_new/api/main.py:1329)
public API VerificationEngine.verify_identity (no in-tree HTTP caller found)
public API VerificationEngine.verify_integral (incl. lower/upper bound strings)
public API SemanticValidator.validate (no in-tree caller found)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/qwed_new/core/verifier.py:200-398 (verify_identity/derivative/integral/limit, extra string params lower_bound/upper_bound/point) and src/qwed_new/core/validator.py:64

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about authenticated HTTP RCE; VerificationEngine.verify_identity/derivative/integral/limit and SemanticValidator have no HTTP caller in the tree, so a solver can argue they are internal library helpers not reachable by an attacker; likewise qwed_sdk's sympify sits in a client-side SDK whose input is LLM output, not an API request.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Natural math input must keep parsing: implicit multiplication ('2x', '2(x+1)'), trig/log/factorial/sqrt functions, constants pi/E/oo, arbitrary symbol names auto-created, and the limit point 'oo'; an over-broad fix (rejecting identifiers, parentheses or attribute-free names, or dropping transformations) breaks identity/derivative/integral/limit verification.

O6_input_shapes: equation string split on first '=' into two sides
secondary string params: expected, lower_bound, upper_bound, point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: qwed_sdk QWEDLocal.verify_math compares the LLM's answer by calling sympy.sympify on the raw answer string (string sympify -> parse_expr -> eval, no restricted namespace); the fix did not touch qwed_sdk.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate client-side SDK package; input is the model's answer rather than an authenticated API request, and the neighbouring expression path already has its own AST allow-list (qwed_sdk/qwed_local.py:411-428), so it looks already hardened.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different top-level package (qwed_sdk vs src/qwed_new), different file, reached via LLM response at qwed_sdk/qwed_local.py:812-844

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a fallback that sympifies the parsed 'expected' value string when it is not numeric
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _parse_math_query returns an expected value that a maintainer could plausibly normalise with sympy.sympify for symbolic answers.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parse task.claimed_answer with sympy.sympify for symbolic claims before calling verify_math
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: LLM-translated claimed answers can be symbolic; sympify is the idiomatic SymPy conversion and bypasses safe_parse_expr.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: variable argument converted with sympify/parse_expr instead of Symbol() to support 'x, y' multi-variable lists
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Multi-variable derivative support is a natural extension; sympify accepts comma lists.

O9_family: code injection via eval-backed expression parser (CWE-94/95)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/test_api_exceptions.py patches parse_expr on /verify/math; fix adds tests/security/test_safe_parser.py (absent at pinned commit). /verify/math needs FastAPI TestClient + tenant/DB dependency (local SQL session); /verify/natural_language needs an LLM provider.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap or deny-list only the two parse_expr calls in the /verify/math handler and stop, leaving batch, VerificationEngine's extra string params and the SDK sympify open.
